vehicle: Volkswagen ID. Polo · 85 kW and 99 kW versions
caseStudy: Independent case study built only from public Volkswagen Group publications, the regulation text and cited literature. It is not issued, endorsed or verified by Volkswagen AG. The serial number, date of manufacture and state-of-health data are illustrative.

sections.title: Identification & labelling
sections.annex: Annex XIII 1(a) · Annex VI Part A
sections.summary: Labelling information that every scan of the QR code shows.

fields.label: Unique battery identifier
fields.note: Illustrative serial in the project's UID scheme. A real passport uses the identifier the economic operator assigns.

fields.label: Battery category
fields.value: Electric vehicle battery

fields.label: Economic operator placing the battery on the market
fields.value: Volkswagen AG, Berliner Ring 2, 38440 Wolfsburg, Germany
fields.note: Vehicle manufacturer. The cells are a unified cell design developed with Volkswagen subsidiary PowerCo.

fields.label: Vehicle application
fields.value: Volkswagen ID. Polo, 85 kW (116 PS) and 99 kW (135 PS) versions · MEB+ platform · front-wheel drive

fields.label: Place of manufacture (battery system)
fields.value: Battery system assembly, Workshop 20, SEAT & CUPRA plant, Martorell (Barcelona), Spain

fields.label: Battery weight
fields.note: Not published. For context: the vehicle's EU kerb weight starts at 1,568 kg.

fields.label: Battery chemistry
fields.value: Lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO₄, LFP)

fields.label: Hazardous substances (other than Hg, Cd, Pb)
fields.note: Typical of LFP cells with liquid electrolyte. The cell safety data sheet is not public.

fields.label: Critical raw materials present (> 0.1 % w/w)
fields.note: Inferred from LFP chemistry and the EU critical raw materials list. No cobalt, no nickel, no manganese.

sections.title: Carbon footprint
sections.summary: Volkswagen has not published an Article 7 declaration yet. The indicative values below come from peer-reviewed literature and are labelled as such.

fields.label: Declared carbon footprint (per kWh of total energy over service life)
fields.note: The declaration becomes mandatory for EV batteries once the Commission's delegated act on the calculation method applies.

fields.label: Carbon footprint performance class
fields.note: Classes will be defined by a later delegated act.

fields.label: Indicative cradle-to-gate footprint, LFP pack (literature)
fields.note: Factory-data LCA of a 1 kWh LFP pack (2026).

fields.label: Published range for LFP pack production
Indicative footprint of this pack
fields.note: 75.5 kg CO₂e/kWh × 38.5 kWh installed energy. Not an Article 7 value.

fields.label: Electricity in Group cell production
fields.value: PowerCo Salzgitter gigafactory runs entirely on wind and solar power
fields.note: Salzgitter started with NMC unified cells; the LFP variant was announced to follow. The production site of this pack's LFP cells is not published.

sections.title: Supply chain due diligence
sections.summary: Information from the economic operator's public due diligence reporting.

fields.label: Due diligence management system
fields.value: Raw Materials Due Diligence Management System, introduced 2020, based on the OECD Due Diligence Guidance

fields.label: Supplier risk management
fields.value: Responsible Supply Chain System (ReSC)

fields.label: Mining standards
fields.value: Cooperation with the Initiative for Responsible Mining Assurance (IRMA)

fields.label: Public reporting
fields.value: Annual Responsible Raw Materials Report (latest edition: 2025)

fields.label: Third-party verified battery due diligence report

sections.title: Recycled & renewable content
sections.summary: LFP contains no cobalt or nickel, so only lithium recycled content is relevant for this battery.

fields.label: Recycled lithium share
fields.note: Legal minimum: 6 % from 18 August 2031, 12 % from 18 August 2036.

fields.label: Recycled cobalt share
fields.value: Not applicable: no cobalt in LFP
fields.note: LFP cathodes (LiFePO₄) contain no cobalt; Article 8 shares only apply to metals present.

fields.label: Recycled nickel share
fields.value: Not applicable: no nickel in LFP
fields.note: LFP cathodes (LiFePO₄) contain no nickel.

fields.label: Recycled lead share
fields.value: Not applicable: no lead in the traction battery
fields.note: Lithium-ion traction batteries contain no lead; the lead target applies to lead-acid batteries.

sections.title: Performance & durability
sections.summary: Electrochemical performance and durability parameters. Values Volkswagen has not published are shown as gaps or as estimates with their method.

fields.label: Installed energy (gross)
fields.note: Martorell assembly reports a 38.5 kWh version with 102 cells for the ID. Polo and CUPRA Raval.

fields.label: Pack architecture
fields.value: Cell-to-pack: cells go straight into the pack with no module housings. Three packs form the energy storage unit. The housing is load-bearing in the body structure, flat in the underbody.

fields.label: Cell format
fields.value: Prismatic Unified Cell, co-developed with PowerCo

fields.label: Energy per cell
fields.note: 38.5 kWh ÷ 102 cells.

fields.label: Nominal voltage
fields.note: Assumes all 102 cells in series at 3.2 V, typical for LFP. Volkswagen has not published the pack voltage.

fields.label: Rated capacity
fields.note: 38.5 kWh ÷ 326 V. To be replaced by the declared value.

fields.label: Original power capability
fields.note: Lower bound implied by the 99 kW drive. Peak battery power is not published.

fields.label: DC charging power (max.)
fields.note: Media-drive data, September 2026. The world-premiere release (April 2026) states 90 kW.

fields.label: Bidirectional charging
fields.value: Vehicle-to-Load as standard, up to 3.6 kW

fields.label: Commercial warranty
fields.value: 8 years or 160,000 km, at least 70 % state of health

fields.label: Expected lifetime in cycles (and reference test)
Capacity threshold for exhaustion
fields.note: The warranty floor is 70 % state of health.

fields.label: Temperature range when not in use
Round-trip energy efficiency (initial and at 50 % cycle life)

sections.title: End of life & collection
sections.summary: Information for end users and waste operators on take-back, collection and recycling.

fields.label: Take-back
fields.value: Producers must take back waste EV batteries free of charge (extended producer responsibility).

fields.label: Separate collection
fields.value: Crossed-out wheeled bin symbol: do not dispose of with household or mixed waste.

fields.label: Group raw material recovery
fields.value: Valuable raw materials are recovered from old batteries and used for new batteries.

sections.title: Detailed composition
sections.summary: Materials used in the cathode, anode and electrolyte, for repairers, recyclers and second-life operators.

fields.label: Cathode
fields.value: LiFePO₄ active material on aluminium current collector
fields.note: Chemistry confirmed by Volkswagen. Collector material is standard for LFP.

fields.label: Anode
fields.value: Graphite on copper current collector
fields.note: Typical LFP cell construction; not published for this cell.

fields.label: Electrolyte
fields.value: LiPF₆ in organic carbonate solvents
fields.note: Typical LFP cell construction; not published for this cell.

fields.label: Separator
fields.value: Polyolefin (PE/PP) microporous film
fields.note: Typical LFP cell construction; not published for this cell.

fields.label: Cell housing
fields.value: Prismatic hard case

fields.label: Pack housing
fields.value: Load-bearing battery housing, part of the body structure

fields.label: Cell manufacturer and plant
fields.note: Volkswagen states the cell was co-developed with PowerCo but has not named the producer of the LFP cells.

sections.title: Repair & dismantling
sections.summary: Part numbers, spare part sources, dismantling information and safety measures.

fields.label: Number of cells and layout
fields.value: 102 cells in three cell-to-pack packs forming one energy storage unit

fields.label: Smallest replaceable unit
fields.value: Pack (one of three). With no module housings, cells cannot be swapped individually.
fields.note: Follows from the cell-to-pack design, which removes module housings.

fields.label: Exploded diagrams, disassembly sequence, fastenings and tools
Safety measures
value: High-voltage system: work only by qualified high-voltage technicians
Isolate and verify absence of voltage before opening the housing
Do not puncture, crush or heat damaged cells; risk of toxic and flammable gas
fields.note: Generic high-voltage safety practice. The manufacturer's repair manual is not public.

fields.label: Vehicle electrical safety approval
fields.value: UN Regulation No. 100 (REESS), required for EU type approval
